decisions.decision: Use shiftyTenantId (NOT tenantId) for Shifty domain tenant on user docs
decisions.rationale: Budibase populates `tenantId` natively with the workspace tenant ('default' in CE single-tenant mode) — overwriting it would risk breaking Budibase's own routing
